Accountability

Corrections & updates.

Accuracy matters. If you believe an article contains an error, contact us with the article URL, the disputed passage and a reliable source where possible.

We will review the report and update material errors with a clear correction note and an updated date. Routine typographical fixes may be made without a separate note. We cannot promise a specific response time.
